name: Dove Detangling Conditioner Intense Repair 170ml | Bangladesh
description:
Dove Intense Repair Detangling Conditioner – 170ml | Bangladesh

Restore smoothness and strength to your hair with Dove Intense Repair Detangling Conditioner. Infused with Keratin Repair Actives, it nourishes and repairs damaged hair from within, helping to reduce breakage and improve resilience. Its gentle, detangling formula makes hair more manageable, leaving it soft, smooth, and healthy-looking—perfect for everyday use.

Key Features:

Keratin Repair Actives: Deeply nourishes and repairs damaged hair

Strengthens from Within: Reduces breakage and restores vitality

Smooth & Manageable: Effortlessly detangles for tangle-free hair

Gentle for Daily Use: Suitable for all hair types

Net Volume: 170ml
Country of Origin: Bangladesh
